notes: Premiums are the cheapest dealer asks on gold.de vs spot on 2026-11-27 (online best-of-market; single shops and banks charge more, e.g. philoro 1oz about +3%). Silver premiums include 19% MwSt. Used gold: online buyers on gold.de paid about 1-16% below 585 melt value (median about 4-5%); walk-in shops often pay 8-15% less. Holding gold over 1 year makes gains tax-free.
